_comment: Controls what C2 (REDUCE) pulls out of the Geofabrik GPKG into the skinny DB. An override at /sdcard/Documents/GroupTrack/config/osm_layers.json takes precedence over this bundled copy; see OsmLayerCatalog.kt. layers.label: Trails and tracks
layers._filter_comment: EXTRACTJOIN-2026-08-30: WIDENED, and the reason the old comment gave is now answered. It said the access tags (ohv, motor_vehicle, access) are NOT in Geofabrik's GeoPackage -- true, and that is why fclass answered by SHAPE rather than permission. The PBF carries them, so the import now downloads it alongside the GeoPackage, joins on osm_id and classifies at extract (OsmPbfTagReader + OsmTrailClassifier). STAGE ONE therefore casts a WIDE net -- everything a side-by-side could plausibly be on -- and STAGE TWO narrows it by real tags. path and bridleway are back IN, no longer excluded by shape: they are now labelled hiking/equestrian and filtered at the point of use. Measured on Utah 08-30: candidates 87,079 -> 125,831, of which 83,916 carry a type from real tags where the baseline was zero. Nothing is dropped -- rows the rules reject arrive as 'private' or 'paved or restricted' with motorized=0.
